title: Indian ports and European powers
scope: European use of force, monopolies and port control in the Indian Ocean; limits of Portuguese cartaz and dependence on Asian rulers and merchants
limitations: Comparative Indian Ocean synthesis; not Ceylon-specific for every mechanism.

title: Labouring Transformations of Amphibious Monsters: Exploring Early Modern Globalization, Diversity, and Shifting Clusters of Labour Relations in the Context of the Dutch East India Company (1600–1800)
author_or_institution: International Review of Social History / Cambridge University Press
scope: VOC labour regimes; Ceylon corvée; chialias/chaleas cinnamon delivery; resistance and revolts
limitations: Labour-history synthesis drawing on VOC records; retain period and district specificity for quantities.

title: Ceylon
author_or_institution: Encyclopaedia of Portuguese Expansion / NOVA FCSH
scope: Portuguese relations with Kotte and establishment of first Colombo fortress in 1518
limitations: Reference synthesis; episode-level treaty language should be checked against edited primary sources for quotation.

title: History of Cinnamon
author_or_institution: Department of Cinnamon Development, Sri Lanka
scope: Dutch initiation of systematic cinnamon cultivation under Iman Willem Falck; British inheritance and expansion
limitations: Government historical synthesis; use specialist academic work for precise acreage, dates and causal interpretation.

title: An Introduction to Sri Lanka and its Cinnamon Industry
author_or_institution: Springer Nature volume chapter / N. R. Dewasiri et al.
scope: Dutch cinnamon gardens/plantations from the late 1760s and late-eighteenth-century expansion
limitations: Convenience URL is ResearchGate; cite the published Springer chapter in final bibliography.

title: Competition or collaboration? Relations between the Dutch East India Company and Indian merchants around 1680
scope: VOC intra-Asian trade and its role in generating precious metals/profits for Asian markets
limitations: VOC-wide rather than Ceylon-specific; supports financing mechanism, not a Ceylon price series.

title: Spending a Windfall
author_or_institution: Nuno Palma and co-author / International Economic Review
scope: Role of American precious metals in enabling early-modern Euro-Asian trade
limitations: Macro-level Europe-Asia argument; does not establish that particular Ceylon cinnamon purchases were directly paid with newly mined American silver.

title: Persians, Pilgrims and Portuguese: The Travails of Masulipatnam Shipping in the Western Indian Ocean, 1590–1665
scope: Anti-Portuguese port networks and Asian shipping that avoided Portuguese-controlled entrepôts
limitations: Coromandel/Bay of Bengal case; used to bound claims of total Portuguese control, not as direct evidence for Ceylon administration.
